# Setup

## Pakete laden

```{r pakete}
library(igraph)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidygraph)
```

## Daten einlesen

```{r daten_einlesen}
el <- read.csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yasemin-k/Awards_Netzwerk/refs/heads/main/Awards_Edgelist.csv",
  header = TRUE, sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

nl <- read.csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yasemin-k/Awards_Netzwerk/refs/heads/main/Awards_Nodelist.csv",
  header = TRUE, sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

# Hypothesentest

## Berechnung der Award-Reihenfolge

```{r hypothese_berechnen}
hypothese <- el %>%
  group_by(from) %>%
  summarise(
    first_gg_emmy_year = if (any(award %in% c("Golden Globe", "Emmys"))) {
      min(year[award %in% c("Golden Globe", "Emmys")])
    } else NA_real_,

    first_oscar_nom_year = if (any(award == "Oscars" & weight == 1)) {
      min(year[award == "Oscars" & weight == 1])
    } else NA_real_,

    first_oscar_win_year = if (any(award == "Oscars" & weight == 2)) {
      min(year[award == "Oscars" & weight == 2])
    } else NA_real_
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gg_emmy_before_oscar_nom =
      !is.na(first_gg_emmy_year) &
      !is.na(first_oscar_nom_year) &
      first_gg_emmy_year < first_oscar_nom_year,

    gg_emmy_before_oscar_win =
      !is.na(first_gg_emmy_year) &
      !is.na(first_oscar_win_year) &
      first_gg_emmy_year < first_oscar_win_year
  )
```

# Tabellen der Ergebnisse

## Personen, bei denen GG/Emmy vor Oscar liegt

```{r trefferliste}
ergebnisse_passend <- hypothese %>%
  filter(gg_emmy_before_oscar_nom | gg_emmy_before_oscar_win) %>%
  arrange(first_gg_emmy_year)

knitr::kable(ergebnisse_passend) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = TRUE,
    bootstrap_options = c("bordered")
  )
```

## Zusammenfassung der Hypothese

```{r hypothese_zusammenfassung}
ergebnis_tabelle <- hypothese %>%
  summarise(
    Gesamtpersonen = n(),
    GG_Emmy_vor_Oscar_Nominierung = sum(gg_emmy_before_oscar_nom, na.rm = TRUE),
    GG_Emmy_vor_Oscar_Gewinn = sum(gg_emmy_before_oscar_win, na.rm = TRUE),
    Anteil_Nominierung_in_Prozent =
      round(mean(gg_emmy_before_oscar_nom, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
    Anteil_Gewinn_in_Prozent =
      round(mean(gg_emmy_before_oscar_win, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)
  )

knitr::kable(
  ergebnis_tabelle,
  caption = "Hypothesentest: GG/Emmy vor späterer Oscar-Nominierung bzw. Gewinn",
  align = "c"
)
```

# Netzwerk

## Filter für Visualisierung

```{r filter}
nl_pretest <- nl %>%
  filter(
    type == "Person",
    sex == "female",
    ethnicity == "White"
  )

el_all <- el %>%
  filter(
    award %in% c("Oscars","Emmys","Golden Globe"),
    category == "acting",
    weight %in% c(1,2)
  ) %>%
  filter(from %in% nl_pretest$id)

el_win <- el %>%
  filter(
    award %in% c("Oscars","Emmys","Golden Globe"),
    category == "acting",
    weight == 2
  ) %>%
  filter(from %in% nl_pretest$id)
```

## Netzwerk erstellen

```{r netzwerk_erstellen}
nl_awards_all <- nl %>% filter(id %in% unique(el_all$to))
nl_vertices_all <- bind_rows(nl_pretest, nl_awards_all) %>%
  distinct(id,.keep_all=TRUE)

aw_all <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = el_all,
  vertices = nl_vertices_all,
  directed = TRUE
)

E(aw_all)$color <- ifelse(E(aw_all)$weight == 2,"red","grey")
E(aw_all)$lty <- ifelse(E(aw_all)$weight == 2,1,2)
E(aw_all)$width <- ifelse(E(aw_all)$weight == 2,2.5,1.2)
```

## tidygraph Objekt (für Abgabe)

```{r tidygraph_objekt}
aw_tbl <- as_tbl_graph(aw_all)
aw_tbl
```

# Visualisierung

## Nominierungen + Gewinne

```{r visualisierung_all, fig.height=10, fig.width=14}
plot(
  aw_all,
  layout = layout_with_fr,
  asp = 0,
  main = "Awards Netzwerk (Nominierungen und Gewinne)",
  vertex.label.cex = 0.8,
  vertex.size = 18,
  edge.color = E(aw_all)$color,
  edge.lty = E(aw_all)$lty,
  edge.width = E(aw_all)$width
)

legend(
  "topleft",
  legend = c("Nominierung","Gewinn"),
  lty = c(2,1),
  lwd = c(1,2.5),
  col = c("grey","red"),
  bty = "n"
)
```

## Nur Gewinner

```{r visualisierung_gewinner, fig.height=10, fig.width=14}
nl_awards_win <- nl %>% filter(id %in% unique(el_win$to))
nl_vertices_win <- bind_rows(nl_pretest, nl_awards_win) %>%
  distinct(id,.keep_all=TRUE)

aw_win <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = el_win,
  vertices = nl_vertices_win,
  directed = TRUE
)

plot(
  aw_win,
  layout = layout_with_fr,
  asp = 0,
  main = "Awards Netzwerk (nur Gewinner)",
  vertex.label.cex = 0.8,
  vertex.size = 18,
  edge.color = "red",
  edge.width = 2
)
```
